features.name: date_centered_z
features.description: Chronological position standardized by the training-fold mean and spread.
features.expected_model_benefit: Gives a linear SVM margin a smooth chronology coordinate for slow market drift.

features.name: period_centered_z
features.description: Within-day period standardized by the training-fold mean and spread.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides linear separation for regular within-day operating regimes.

features.name: nsw_price_z_clipped
features.description: NSW price deviation from its training-fold mean, clipped to reduce outlier leverage.
features.expected_model_benefit: Stabilizes extreme NSW price spikes while preserving ordered severity.

features.name: vic_price_log_pressure
features.description: Log-scaled VIC price pressure relative to its training-fold spread.
features.expected_model_benefit: Compresses rare VIC price spikes into a smooth severity axis.

features.name: price_spread_z_clipped
features.description: NSW-minus-VIC price gap standardized by training-fold location and scale, then clipped.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures regional price contrast as a single approximately linear pressure coordinate.

features.name: aggregate_demand_z
features.description: Combined NSW and VIC demand level standardized with training-fold mean sum and scale sum.
features.expected_model_benefit: Represents broad load level with reduced collinearity versus separate demands.

features.name: demand_balance_z
features.description: NSW-minus-VIC demand imbalance after removing the training-fold average gap.
features.expected_model_benefit: Separates regional load mix from total load, aiding margin orientation.

features.name: nsw_price_demand_log_ratio
features.description: Log NSW price per unit of NSW demand with a small denominator stabilizer.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures price stress relative to local load using a smooth ratio.

features.name: transfer_centered_z
features.description: Transfer value standardized by training-fold mean and spread.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides the margin with a direct interconnector-flow coordinate.

features.name: transfer_demand_alignment_clipped
features.description: Clipped product of standardized transfer and standardized demand imbalance.
features.expected_model_benefit: Exposes a row-level interaction between flow level and regional load imbalance.

features.name: operational_stress_judgment_score
features.description: Semantic 0.0-1.0 assessment of overall operating stress from price spike severity, high combined demand, demand imbalance, and transfer extremity; uses same-row fields with fixed training-fold reference statistics.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds an expert-style severity axis summarizing multiple row-level anomalies for linear separation.

features.name: regional_coupling_judgment_score
features.description: Semantic 0.0-1.0 assessment of how coherent the row is across NSW/VIC price gap, demand gap, and transfer level; low means weak or conflicting coupling, high means strong consistent coupling.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds a compact nonlinear coherence cue while staying interpretable for a linear SVM margin.
